rootsclassic.name: Roots Classic
rootsclassic.description: Classic port of Roots, the Druidic Magic Mod

totemic.name: Totemic
totemic.description: A magic mod about Totem Poles, nature and the power of music.

botania.name: Botania Revived
botania.description: Unofficial NeoForge Port Of Botania(Botania is a mod that adds nature magic to Minecraft).

ars_nouveau.name: Ars Nouveau
ars_nouveau.description: Craft spells, create powerful baubles, and summon magical creatures!

occultism.name: Occultism
occultism.description: A magic mod inspired by the world of Jonathan Stroud's Bartimaeus. With the help of occult rituals players can summon entities from the "Other Side" to perform magic.

naturesaura.name: NaturesAura
naturesaura.description: Nature's Aura is a Minecraft mod about collecting, using and replenishing the Aura naturally present in the world to create useful devices and unique mechanics.

enchanted.name: Enchanted
enchanted.description: Witchcraft and Occultism based on real history and folklore.

irons_spellbooks.name: Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks
irons_spellbooks.description: A magic mod for Minecraft returning to the classic RPG spellcasting fantasy.

apotheosis.name: Apotheosis
apotheosis.description: All things that should have been

aether.name: The Aether
aether.description: The Aether Team presents the original Aether mod! Up to date for modern Minecraft versions and fully compatible with multiplayer. The Aether is a dimension of floating islands high in the sky. Ascend through a Glowstone portal and begin a new survival adventure packed with new ores, mythical creatures and perilous Dungeons!

silentgear.name: Silent Gear
silentgear.description: Modular and upgradeable tools, weapons, and armor. Allows full customization of materials and parts used in gear crafting, even user-defined ones!

botanypots.name: BotanyPots
botanypots.description: Pots for growing different types of plants.

reliquary.name: Reliquary Reincarnations
reliquary.description: Two words: magical swag. Oh, and a gun.

goety.name: Goety
goety.description: Goety adds new mobs that can help or hinder players and a magic system that gives players a different way to fight.

gobber2.name: Gobber for NeoForge
gobber2.description: Adds lots of armor, tools, weapons, and OP items

silentgems.name: Silent's Gems
silentgems.description: Adds gems, ores, and other trinkets. Complete with Silent Gear compatibility!

ars_creo.name: Ars Creo
ars_creo.description: A create addon for Ars Nouveau

ars_elemental.name: Ars Elemental
ars_elemental.description: This Ars Nouveau add-on is about the Elemental Schools. More spell foci and equips, powering up one of the elemental schools, as well as new glyphs and hidden combos.

artifacts.name: Artifacts
artifacts.description: Adds various new powerful uncraftable items to make exploration a bit more interesting
